name: AMO-Bench
intro: AMO-Bench论文v1报告由数学专家原创并给出逐步解答，经至少3名专家盲审、10-gram与网页原创性筛查，以及人类IMO难度确认和多模型失败筛选，最终保留50题。每题生成32个回答；39题由解析器评分，11题由o4-mini五次裁判多数投票评分，混合评分器在1000个回答上达到99.2%准确率。官方仓库后来修订Problem 35，并记录Problem 26及38/39的相似性反馈。
org: Meituan, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, Harbin Institute of Technology
build_method: 数学专家原创出题, 三人以上盲审, 原创性与难度复核
metric: AVG@32, Pass@k（含Pass@32）, 输出长度与类别分解
eval_feature: IMO级难度, 原创防泄漏, 解析器与LLM混合评分
build_method_en: Expert-authored original problems, three-or-more-expert blind review, originality and difficulty review
eval_feature_en: IMO-level difficulty, original leakage-resistant tasks, parser and LLM hybrid grading
intro_en: The AMO-Bench v1 paper reports expert-authored problems and step-by-step solutions, blind review by at least three experts, 10-gram and web originality screening, human IMO-level difficulty confirmation, and multi-model failure filtering to retain 50 problems. Each model produces 32 responses per problem; 39 items use parser grading and 11 use five-vote o4-mini judging, with the hybrid grader reaching 99.2% accuracy on 1,000 responses. The official repository later revised Problem 35 and records similarity feedback for Problem 26 and Problems 38/39.
metric_en: AVG@32, Pass@k (including Pass@32), output length and category breakdowns
drawio_review_note: Reviewed against arXiv:2510.26768v1 Sections 2.1-2.3, Section 3.1, and Appendices A-C, plus the official meituan-longcat/AMO-Bench repository. The v1 paper reports expert creation, blind review by at least three experts, 10-gram/web/expert-memory originality screening, and a difficulty gate requiring at least two advanced models to fail 3/3 correctness. Evaluation samples 32 responses, routes 39 parser-compatible and 11 descriptive answers to separate graders, reports AVG@32 and Pass@k, and exposes AMO-Bench-P as an optional 39-item subset. The 1,000-response, 99.2% grader validation is separate pre-evaluation QA. Post-release caveats remain explicit: Problem 35 was revised; Problem 26 appears effectively identical to an existing contest problem; Problems 38/39 appear similar to two arXiv papers.
